about_the_game:
🧊 This isn’t your typical Tetris

It takes block-matching to a whole new dimension.
🧠 3D horizontal & vertical clears make spatial decisions far more thrilling than traditional Tetris.
It’s not just about “filling holes efficiently”; it’s about:
✔ Creating multi-line combos in 3D space
✔ Planning energy surges ahead of time
✔ Pulling off a spectacular comeback when your energy is about to drop

“Smart clearing” beats passive survival.
Every move requires strategy and foresight.

🎧 Rhythm-driven system
Blocks aren’t just stacked slowly—you’re racing against the energy bar to the beat of the music.
The rhythm drives the pressure, the pressure fuels your thinking, and the satisfaction comes naturally.

⚡ Energy-focused progression, not “time survival”
It’s not about surviving as long as possible—it’s about pushing your energy to full.
Every chain, every precise move brings you closer to victory.
Failure isn’t about being slow—it’s about not creating enough satisfying moments.

🌌 3D visuals + reactive environment
Energy rises, the world comes alive;
Energy falls, the environment cools down.
The game isn’t a static board—it’s a living, breathing rhythm machine.

⭐ Key takeaway
This game doesn’t test how long you can survive—it rewards how skillfully and boldly you play.

Players will immediately feel:
✔ It’s more than a reskin
✔ Gameplay philosophy evolved
✔ Satisfaction mechanics upgraded
✔ Worth trying, worth collecting

Every level is a rhythm experiment.

No repeated solutions. Every clear is a new challenge.

Each stage demands a different way of thinking in space.

You’re not clearing blocks. You’re designing the perfect burst.

name: Boom Cube

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GT 730 / AMD Radeon R7 240 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or better
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 / AMD RX 560 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 MB available space

short_description: Not your usual Tetris. 3D horizontal vertical clears push spatial strategy. Plan combos, trigger energy bursts, and reverse near-zero energy. Rhythm-driven gameplay keeps you on edge. Smart clearing beats passive survival. Visual and audio feedback reward skillful play. Worth trying and collecting.
supported_languages: English, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean
